messages:
alex: FYI support ticket from StellaPay — p99 has climbed from ~900ms to ~4.1s over the last 45m, customers hitting intermittent 502/504s. Worker pods reporting OOM kills and long stall periods.

morgan: which pool/region? tenant id?

alex: us-east-1, pool redwood-ded-07, tenant stella-pay. Logs pasted below. Impacting multiple GPUs in the pool.

jamie: I'll pull allocator and kv metrics. Any recent model swaps or rollout?

alex: deploy-bot says no deploys in the last 8h.

deploy-bot: [deploy] no deploy activity for pool redwood-ded-07 in the past 8 hours :white_check_mark:

ana: runtime telemetry: gradual increase in GPU resident + fragmentation ratio. tenant_kv increased from 0.9GB -> 5.6GB over ~35m. allocator churn high, reclaim attempts failing. p95 ok, p99 exploded.

ben: customer says "sudden tail latency, sometimes full request aborts." They asked for immediate mitigation.

morgan: short mitigation plan: 1) reduce batch size for stella-pay 2) enable aggressive per-tenant KV eviction 3) schedule slab compaction on hot hosts 4) capture memory and GPU maps. Who can run the ops commands?

ana: running compaction on n-17 and n-18 now. Curl I used:
```
curl -X POST "https://infra-api.internal/nodes/n-17/maintenance/compact?mode=aggressive" -H "Authorization: Bearer ***"
```

ana: heap profile shows many tiny KV entries (avg 96 bytes) from chat-turn cache; eviction lagging. GPU buddy allocator shows many small free blocks.

jamie: allocator logs:
```
[allocator] fragmentation_ratio: 0.62 -> 0.88
[allocator] free_chunks: 140 -> 22
[oom] reclaim_failed tenant=stella-pay attempts=3
```

morgan: propose emergency knobs: set tenant.batch_max_tokens=32, kv.eviction_multiplier=4, allocator.compact_interval_sec=45. Also can route traffic to smaller-context model variant (llama-7b-8k) while we stabilize. Thoughts?

lina: smaller model will change output quality. Need customer OK before full cutover. Customer ops: can they tolerate smaller context for a short window?

ben: reached out to customer; they're open to a temporary fallback if it fixes latency. Authorizing canary to 15%.

alex: applying routing change for 15% traffic to the smaller variant:
```
POST /routing/tenants/stella-pay
{ "fallback_variant": "llama-7b-8k-q4", "pct": 15 }
```

ana: compaction completed on n-17,n-18 and n-21. fragmentation dropped ~12-18% on those hosts and GPU OOMs stopped on them. Captured before/after dumps.
\
jamie: pushed ephemeral allocator settings to pool redwood-ded-07:
```
allocator.compact_interval_sec=45
allocator.free_threshold=0.22
kv.eviction_multiplier=4
```
Applied via orchestration to the pool.

morgan: reduced batch_max_tokens to 32 for tenant stella-pay at the edge.

alex: results after ~10m: p99 decreased from 4.1s -> 1.3s, p95 steady. No new OOM kills in the last 20m across the pool.

ben: customer confirms improved responsiveness and agreed to keep the 15% fallback for now.

ana: preliminary root cause: combination of unbounded small-key KV growth (long conversational histories + prefix caching) and allocator fragmentation on older GPU hosts. When reclaim failed, requests took slow-paths causing tail latency and eventual OOM kills.
\
jamie: follow ups: 1) enforce per-tenant soft limits (auto-evict at 2GB, hard block at 4GB unless approved) 2) enable periodic slab defrag on hosts older than 12 months 3) add alert if fragmentation_ratio > 0.8 for any host 4) document safe escalation knobs and rollback steps.

morgan: creating incident: INC-2026-4421 and scheduling a 2hr post-incident sync. Adding runbook edits and automation to divert traffic when tenant_kv > 3GB.

alex: sharing a sanitized repro script for staging so SRE can validate fixes:
```
for i in {1..300}; do
  curl -s -X POST https://staging-api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer SK_STAGING" -d '{"model":"llama-70b","prompt":"repeat long context...","max_tokens":512,"stream":false}' &
done
wait
```
This creates the small-key KV pattern we saw.

lina: reminder: avoid full host restarts unless compaction + knobs don't help — restarts spike cold starts and can worsen tail.

ben: closing loop with customer: "We've applied temporary fallback + memory tuning; monitoring shows p99 improvement. We'll follow up with permanent safeguards." :thumbsup:

morgan: closing here. We'll keep the canary and watch for 2h then roll back knobs slowly. Incident lead assigned to jamie + ana.

inc-bot: incident INC-2026-4421 created and assigned to runtime + sre team. ETA for initial doc: 2h.

alex: thanks everyone — marking this escalation as resolved from support once we hit 2h stable window.

ben: customer said "Thanks, latency is back to normal". Marking resolved on support side.

morgan: follow-up actions assigned in the incident. We'll produce a postmortem with concrete allocator defaults and tenant limits.
